Adjacent tasks PAIR-CARRIER-SERVICES-001 (the carrier family; this service is its social member -- it carries the voice of the holder), BANKING-SYSTEM-001 (the same transportability and KV-by-choice determinations for the treasury surface) and SKAP-HOSTNAME-BINDING-001 (the public binding of the vault) are different tasks; this item references all three and builds on the SKAP Vault and Facilitator Client services directly

record.goal: Build governed social posting as a TRANSPORTABLE service that works with ANY KV: an enrolled posting component receives the platform credential from the SKAP Vault per act (release receipted, credential never persisted, never held by any lane or chat), posts under the holder standing terms held as data in the holder own KV, and binds every post (content hash, destination, platform post id, terms version) as a receipt pair whose record lives in the holder KV. The service holds no record of its own and instantiates from its package against any KV that speaks the grammar; the ecosystem KV is specimen only, never a dependency. The principal irreducible acts are authentication (the OAuth consent, whose token -- never a password -- is the vault deposit) and judgment (the standing terms); posting itself is transport and is machinery work. Doors tested in order: the connector-held surfaces (Facebook, Instagram, Threads) first, then the LinkedIn self-use member-social door, its gate filed in six-field form if it fails on evidence. Portability is discharged, not asserted: the service is instantiated against a second, independent KV and a post is executed and replayed from that KV record alone. The operative text is the queue item in the Ecosystem KV (QUEUE__WORK__SOCIAL_POSTING__01, Drive 1mN2Vt82Vaoe2M7arPrOxAW5dZR7d218G, MD5 26075a414cfec3e3b25999a610b0c7c0). Work items: P-1 posting component; P-2 credential deposits; P-3 standing terms; P-4 specimen post; P-5 LinkedIn route; P-6 transport proof; P-7 record surface. Discharge per item is its named evidence read back; P-4 and P-6 name live evidence only. Failure filing: six-field non-ALLOW; first claim owns each item.
